chunks: On the day when every soul will come pleading for itself, and every soul will be recompensed for what it had done, no one will be wronged.
ai.seo_question: What happens to every soul on the Day of Judgment regarding their deeds and justice?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nahl underscores the principle of 'Tawaffa' (full recompense), highlighting that divine justice ensures no deed, however small, is lost. It reflects the individual accountability central to the Day of Judgment, where each soul bears the weight of its own actions without external interference or injustice.
